title: Phase-0 structured OSINT labels
description: Versioned label schema for public open-source reporting only. Online EN hosts; no conflict-zone field collection; no civilian-targeting or PII fields.

safety.notes_en: Labels describe public events from allowlisted news/official sources. Do not encode targeting intent, named private individuals, or sub-city coordinates.

event_type.description: Public event class from open reporting

location_public.description: Public city/region or named public facility only

location_granularity.description: Campaign-level granularity expectation (not a submission label)

event_time.description: Public event date/time as reported (ISO date preferred)

equipment_type.description: Platform/equipment category visible in public reporting

source_url.description: Allowlisted public EN news or official host URL
